component.subject: Adoration
component.author: Thomas Ken
component.source: Thomas Ken's doxology, the closing stanza of his Morning Hymn, in A Manual of Prayers for the Use of the Scholars of Winchester College (1755 edition). The third line, "Praise him above, ye heavenly host", is here rendered "Praise God above you, heavenly host", an inclusive-language change in use in several modern hymnals.

original.p: Praise God, from whom all Blessings flow; Praise him, all Creatures here below; Praise him above, ye heavenly Host; Praise Father, Son, and Holy Ghost.

p.line: Praise God from whom all blessings flow;
Praise God, all creatures here below;
Praise God above you, heavenly host;
Praise Father, Son, and Holy Ghost. Amen.
